title: What The Guitar Knows — EN/ES/IT (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 102bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal music philosophy Spanish Italian language learning
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The guitar is democratic — it goes everywhere the owner goes
It fits in a case the size of a child and nobody knows
It's there until it comes out at a gathering of some kind
And then it becomes the furniture of everyone's mind

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
La guitarra es democrática — va donde va su dueño
[The guitar is democratic — it goes where its owner goes]
Cabe en un estuche como un niño — ningún empeño
[It fits in a case like a child — no effort needed]
Nadie sabe que está ahí hasta que sale en la reunión
[Nobody knows it's there until it comes out at the gathering]
Y entonces se convierte en el mueble de la conversación
[And then it becomes the furniture of the conversation]

[Chorus — English]
What does the guitar know that I don't know?
It knows that three chords and the truth is the whole show
What does the guitar know in the hands of someone good?
It knows that music lives in wood and wire — always would
That's my boy

[Bridge — Italian, with English translation]
La chitarra è democratica — segue il suo proprietario ovunque
[The guitar is democratic — it follows its owner everywhere]
Entra in una custodia della dimensione di un bambino — alcune
[It fits in a case the size of a child — some]
Cose non cambiano mai — la chitarra è sempre pronta
[Things never change — the guitar is always ready]
Tre accordi e la verità — questa è la sua risposta punta
[Three chords and the truth — that is its precise answer]

[Outro — All three languages]
What the guitar knows… Lo que sabe la guitarra… Quello che sa la chitarra
Three chords, the truth — Tres acordes, la verdad — Tre accordi, la verità
That's my boy
